questions.question: At which ground did Rethabile Motlhanke record their career-best bowling figures (2-25, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval, against Warriors on 2024/10/27.

questions.question: Who has achieved the fifty and 3 wickets in a match double more times, Elriesa Theunissen or Khushi Mistry?
questions.explanation: Elriesa Theunissen: 2 times. Khushi Mistry: 1 times.

questions.question: What was the name of the women's rebel team that toured South Africa during the 1970s and 1980s?
questions.explanation: The Unicorns toured SA from 1972 to 1985/86.
